_doc: D3-01 P5 heist casts (ENV D). heist -> role -> [character ids]; each id's scene is res://world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn (characters.json lists them). Roles are generic until the heist docs name people. Reused ids are D1/D2 characters cast again (D-063 reserved the tellers, guests and waitress for P5). Faction-variant ids (<id>_frd|_sentinel|_zero) are picked per difficulty by EnemyDef.params.visual_variant (characters.md v1.6), so only the base ids are listed. Hand-maintained by ENV D; checked by game/tests/d/test_p5_cast.gd.

notes.gallery_night: Halberd Gallery Security is the gallery's in-house guard (bottle-green blazer, Halberd crest), not Halden or Northgate. The curator is the keycard carrier and the one pale suit at the gala.
notes.meridian_federal: Tellers keep the D2-02 bank livery and the new day manager (keycard carrier) matches it. Guards are Halden Security: the day officers (peaked cap) and the bare-headed night guard (camera operator). civilian_customer_b is the elderly customer; bank_customer_b is the parent with a backpack.
notes.rolling_thunder: The crew works for Vaultline Armored Transport (original). The escort is the police/TAC roster plus its frd/sentinel/zero reskins by difficulty; no new escort model.
notes.afterhours: Staff wear black and the Velvet's violet; patrons are mixed club wear. club_bouncer_b's Hip/Socket is on a belt radio; club_bouncer's is the default hip seat (radio under the bomber is not modelled).
